# Load and clean files

## LAI data import

```{r}
## Read LAI .txt data, rename its columns & convert from century break to full year
LAI_full <- read.table("data raw/NSAS LAI.txt", header = TRUE, strip.white = TRUE) %>%
  rename(component = Area, 
         year = Year, 
         LAI_unit = LAIUnit, 
         fortnight = Fortnight, 
         LAI_9mm = L..9) %>%
  mutate(year = ifelse(year >= 100, 2000 + (year - 100),1900 + year),
         component = case_when(component == "Or/Sh" ~ "Shetland_Orkney", 
                               component == "CNS" ~ "Banks",
                               component == "SNS" ~ "Downs", 
                               TRUE ~ component),
         component = as.factor(component),
         LAI_unit = as.factor(LAI_unit),
         fortnight = as.factor(fortnight))

## Read LAI_components .csv, convert it into longformat & rename columns for continuity
LAI_component <- read_csv("data raw/NSAS LAI Components 2025.csv") %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -c(1), names_to = "year", values_to = "LAI_perc.") %>%
  rename(component = ...1) %>%
  mutate(component = case_when(component == "LAI-ORSH" ~ "Shetland_Orkney",
                               component == "LAI-BUN" ~ "Buchan",
                               component == "LAI-CNS" ~ "Banks",
                               component == "LAI-SNS" ~ "Downs"),
         component = as.factor(component),
         year = as.numeric(year),
         LAI_perc. = LAI_perc. * 100)

## Read SSB_2025 .csv & and rename columns for continuity
Herring_full <- read_csv("data raw/NSAS SSB 2025.csv") %>%
  dplyr::select(-1) %>%
  rename(SSB = value, cv = CV, l_bnd = lbnd, u_bnd = ubnd)  

### *(SSB = SSB in Tonnes, cv = coefficient of variation, l_bnd = lower limit of 95% CI & u_bnd = upper limit of 95% CI)

## read ICES data & fill to lenght
ICES_data <- read.csv("data raw/NSAS ICES data 2024.txt", fill = TRUE)
ICES_data[nrow(ICES_data) + 1, ] <- NA

### Add F & R from to Herring_full
Herring_full$F <- ICES_data$F
Herring_full$Recruitment <- ICES_data$Recruitment
  

## Split SSB Data by components & 95% bounds by component percentage and attach it and LAI percent data to SSB
Herring_LAI <- Herring_full %>%
  left_join(LAI_component, by = "year") %>%
  mutate(SSB_component = SSB * (LAI_perc. / 100),
         l_bnd_component = l_bnd * (LAI_perc. / 100),
         u_bnd_component = u_bnd * (LAI_perc. / 100),
         Recruitment = as.integer(Recruitment * (LAI_perc. / 100))) %>%
  dplyr::select(year, component, LAI_perc., SSB_component, l_bnd_component, u_bnd_component, F, Recruitment) %>%
  drop_na()

```

## Environmental data import

```{r}
### Load functions from "functions.R"
source("R/functions.R")

### Call "load_enironment_data" from functions and store in environment
env_data_full <- load_environmental_data(
  sst_file = "data raw/NS SST Monthly.nc", 
  sss_file = "data raw/NS SSS Monthly.nc")

### Call process_env_data and save as data frame for full stock
#### Full Stock
env_df_full <- process_env_data_seasonal(env_data_full, include_sbt = FALSE)

#### Components
env_df_subset <- process_env_data_seasonal(env_data_full, 
                                           shapefile_path = "data raw/components_shp/components.shp", 
                                           polygon_id_column = "component",
                                           include_sbt = FALSE)

### Clear large data
env_data_full <- NULL
```

## CPR data import

```{r}
### Read data to environment
cpr_small <- read.csv("data raw/NS CPR/CPR_RegimeShift_Data_SmallZooplankton_10062025.csv")
cpr_phyto <- read.csv("data raw/NS CPR/CPR_RegimeShift_Data_Phytoplankton_10062025.csv")

### Call "Process_food_availability" from functions and save as df in lists
#### Full Stock
cpr_full <- list()
cpr_full$phyto <- process_food_availability(cpr_phyto)
cpr_full$small <- process_food_availability(cpr_small)

#### Components
cpr_component <- list()
cpr_component$phyto <- process_food_availability(cpr_phyto, "data raw/components_shp/components.shp", "component")
cpr_component$small <- process_food_availability(cpr_small, "data raw/components_shp/components.shp", "component")

### Clear large data
cpr_small <- NULL
cpr_phyto <- NULL

### Call "test_data_quality" from functions
test_data_quality(cpr_full$phyto)       # Both metrics usable
test_data_quality(cpr_full$small)       # Both metrics usable
test_data_quality(cpr_component$phyto)  # Both metrics usable
test_data_quality(cpr_component$small)  # Both metrics usable
```

# Visual investigation

## LAI visualization

```{r}
Herring_LAI$component <- factor(Herring_LAI$component, levels = c("Shetland_Orkney", "Buchan", "Banks", "Downs"))
LAI_component$component <- factor(LAI_component$component, levels = c("Shetland_Orkney", "Buchan", "Banks", "Downs"))

## Plot timeseries of LAI by component
### Add LAI by year
LAI_aggregated <- LAI_full %>%
  group_by(year, component) %>%
  summarise(LAI_9mm_sum = sum(LAI_9mm),
    .groups = 'drop') %>%
  mutate(component = factor(component, levels = c("Shetland_Orkney", "Buchan", "Banks", "Downs")))
  
### Plot aggregated LAI
plot_LAI_byyear <- ggplot(LAI_aggregated, aes(x = year, 
                    y = LAI_9mm_sum, 
                    color = component,
                    shape = component)) +
  geom_point(size = 1.5, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8, alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_color_viridis_d(option = "mako", begin = 0.1, end = 0.8) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("Shetland_Orkney" = 16, "Buchan" = 17, "Banks" = 15, "Downs" = 18)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, NA)) +
  labs(title = "Aggregated Component LAI", 
       x = "Year", 
       y = "LAI",
       color = "Component",
       shape = "Component") +
  guides(color = guide_legend(), shape = guide_legend()) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
        axis.title.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = 10)),
        axis.title.y = element_text(margin = margin(r = 10)))
plot_LAI_byyear

## Plot stacked bar chart for components percentage of LAI
plot_LAI_percent <- ggplot(LAI_component, aes(x = as.factor(year), 
                              y = LAI_perc., fill = component)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack") + # Create stacked bars
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "mako", begin = 0.1, end = 0.8) +  # Use mako palette with capped range
  labs(title = "LAI Contribution (%)",
       x = "Year",
       y = "LAI Percentage (%)",
       fill = "Component") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        axis.title.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = 10)),
        axis.title.y = element_text(margin = margin(r = 10)))
plot_LAI_percent

### SSB component overlay
plot_SSB_component <- ggplot(Herring_LAI, aes(x = year, y = SSB_component / 1e6, color = component, fill = component)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = l_bnd_component / 1e6,
                  ymax = u_bnd_component / 1e6), alpha = 0.3, color = NA) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  scale_color_viridis_d(option = "mako", begin = 0.1, end = 0.8) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "mako", begin = 0.1, end = 0.8) +
  labs(title = "SSB by Component",
       x = "Year",
       y = "SSB in million t") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
        axis.title.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = 10)),
        axis.title.y = element_text(margin = margin(r = 10)))
plot_SSB_component

### R component overlay
plot_R_component <- ggplot(Herring_LAI, aes(x = year, y = Recruitment / 1e6, color = component, fill = component)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  scale_color_viridis_d(option = "mako", begin = 0.1, end = 0.8) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "mako", begin = 0.1, end = 0.8) +
  labs(title = "R by Component",
       x = "Year",
       y = "R in billions") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
        axis.title.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = 10)),
        axis.title.y = element_text(margin = margin(r = 10)))
plot_R_component
```
